Unified archive library, ported from mholt/archives (Go).

Single entry point for the high-level one-shot API (compress/decompress, archiveDir, extractAll...). Nothing is re-exported: import the specific modules you need for types and low-level access (archive/registry, archive/types, archive/io, archive/formats/...). Call registerDefaults() once before Identify/archive/extract. For streaming, reusable buffers, or custom handler settings, use the registry handlers and codec modules directly.
